scheme_name: Internship Scheme For PG/Research Students In Directorate General Of Trade Remedies (DGTR)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Postgraduate Student or a Research Scholar
Applicant must be from a recognized University/Institute
Internship must be part of the course curriculum or undertaken as an additional assignment during annual vacations
benefits_summary: Certificate of Internship awarded upon successful completion (no financial aid or stipend provided).
application_link: General Administration Section Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR) Ministry of Commerce Jeevan Tara Building, New Delhi, Delhi 110001
